# Copilot instructions: Chemistry Play

A touch-first chemistry game for kids 6–8, played offline on an iPad. Before changing anything, read [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md). Its "App design rules" (which point to PLAN.md §2, §8, and §9) and its ticket notes apply to Copilot too:

- Done means it serves and loads with no console errors.
- Never merge into `main`, because that deploys to the iPad.
- No personal information in this public repo.

## Tickets

When working or reviewing a ticket, or when asked to "work the next ticket" or "review the next ticket", follow `tickets/PROTOCOL.md`. Who builds and who reviews each ticket is set by the coordinator (`tickets/COORDINATOR.md`).
